hero.title: An organization that *sees* itself whole and decides faster
hero.lede: BlackGust connects the systems you already run — ERP, accounting, CRM, documents, requests, cameras — into one model of your organization and puts AI agents to work on it. Every deviation, however small, surfaces before it becomes a problem. Leaders get sourced answers in seconds, and the organization scales without losing control.

problem.label: The problem
problem.title: The data exists. The picture doesn't. Decisions arrive late.
problem.text: In a large organization, information lives in a dozen systems and hundreds of spreadsheets. Answering one simple question from leadership takes analysts a week of stitching exports together. By the time a decision is made, the numbers are already stale.

cells.p: Sales in the CRM, finance in the ERP, inventory in Excel, requests in messengers and on paper. Nothing is connected.
Consolidated reports are assembled by hand over days. Copy-paste errors go unnoticed, and decisions run on yesterday's data.
Qualified staff spend hours on reconciliations, emails, data entry and answering the same questions.

cells.h: AI was tried and didn't stick
cells.p: A chatbot with no access to real data and processes changes nothing. Three months later, nobody uses it.

what.label: What BlackGust is
what.title: A platform and engineers. Neither works without the other.
what.text: We don't sell a license and walk away. Our engineers come on site, learn your processes, connect your systems and stay until the solution is part of daily work. The platform stays with you and grows with the organization.

security.title: Answers for your security team
security.lede: This page is written for information security professionals: where data is stored, who can see it, what an AI agent can and cannot do, and how to verify all of it.

data.label: Data
data.title: Where the data is and who sees it
qa: In the deployment option you choose: BlackGust Cloud in-region, your private cloud, your own servers, or an air-gapped environment. Personal data stays in the jurisdiction its law requires.
Is data used to train models?
No. Cloud models are accessed through enterprise APIs whose terms exclude training on customer data. Local models run entirely inside your infrastructure.
Only the fragments needed to answer. Personal data is masked before it leaves. In air-gapped deployments, external calls are disabled completely.
Only the named engineers on the project, as agreed with you and for the duration of the work. All access is logged and revoked at handover.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. In on-premises deployments, the client holds the keys.
At the end of the contract, data is deleted within the agreed period and a deletion certificate is issued.

agents.label: Agents
agents.title: What an AI agent can and cannot do
agents.text: An agent never gets more rights than the person it acts for. Every limit is set in configuration and enforced by the platform, not by the model.
can: Read data within the user's permissions
cannot: Change or delete data in systems of record
Execute payments or legally binding actions

cells.p: Roles are inherited from Active Directory or LDAP. Object access is restricted down to rows and fields.
Every query, answer, source and action, with timestamp and user. Exportable to your SIEM.
Threshold rules on amount, document type or new counterparty route an action for sign-off.
A set of control questions runs before every agent update. A drop in quality blocks the release.
Incoming requests are checked for attempts to override instructions or reach other users' data.
A non-disclosure agreement before the diagnostic. Data-protection obligations in the main contract.

verify.label: Verification
verify.title: Vet us before work begins
verify.text: We'll provide an architecture description and threat model, and complete your security questionnaire. An engineer can meet your security team before the contract is signed.

company.title: Founded in Tashkent. Working wherever results are needed.
company.lede: BlackGust is the international brand of the AI integrator AISolution. We build an operating brain for large organizations on top of the systems they already run, so that every detail is visible and the organization can scale without losing control. Headquarters in Tashkent; projects in Uzbekistan and beyond.

why.label: Why we exist
why.title: Large organizations deserve tools that understand their language and their processes
paras: Large companies and public bodies in emerging markets are sold AI products built for somewhere else: without their languages, without integration into their accounting and ERP systems, without regard for local data rules.

We work the other way round. We start from a specific organization's processes, connect to its systems, and account for its language and regulation. Then we stay until the solution is part of how the work gets done.

faq.title: The questions we hear most often
faq.lede: Grouped by role, because a founder, a CFO and a security lead ask different things. If yours isn't here, include it in your request and an engineer will answer.

groups.title: General
items: What is BlackGust, in plain terms?

A platform plus a team of engineers. The platform links data from your systems into one picture and gives AI agents safe access to it. The engineers embed that into the work of specific departments, from leadership questions to document processing.
How is this different from a ChatGPT chatbot?

A chatbot knows what's on the internet. Our agents work with your data — contracts, accounting, CRM — within the user's permissions, cite their sources and can take actions inside your processes. On top of that: audit logs, controls, and deployment in your jurisdiction or on your servers.
Do you sell a product or services?
Both. The platform is the foundation the solution is built on. Our engineers' work is what makes it useful for your organization specifically. We don't sell the license on its own without delivery.
Who are your clients?
Large enterprises, state enterprises and government bodies. The platform is built for organizations with many departments, systems and people.
Do you work outside Uzbekistan?
Yes. We're headquartered in Tashkent and take on projects internationally. Our engineers travel to the client.
How are BlackGust and AISolution related?
BlackGust is the international brand of [AISolution](/aisolution). Same team, same platform, same accountability.

groups.title: Founder & CEO
items: What impact can we expect?

It depends on the process. Typical outcomes: routine operations take a fraction of the time, leadership questions are answered in seconds instead of days, and fewer losses come from missed deadlines. The diagnostic gives a concrete estimate for your organization, built on your numbers.
How long until the first result?
An opportunity map with estimates in 2–3 weeks. A working pilot on one process 4–8 weeks after the diagnostic.
What if it doesn't work?
The project is split into phases with separate acceptance. Your minimum exposure is the cost of the diagnostic, {diagnostic}. If we don't find a process with measurable impact, we say so.
Why not build this with our own IT team?

You can, if your team has experience with language models, agents, local-language speech and AI quality evaluation. It's usually faster to start with us and train your engineers in parallel; knowledge transfer is part of every engagement.
Will we become dependent on you?
We design to keep dependency low: documentation, configuration access, training for your engineers. Models can be swapped, and the data stays with you.
Who will work on our project?
A lead engineer who runs the project from diagnostic to launch, plus a team sized to the task. You'll know their names and experience before we start.

groups.title: Finance
items: How much does it cost?

The consultation is free. The diagnostic is {diagnostic} (credited toward the pilot), pilots start at {pilot}. The platform is an annual subscription from {annual} per year; government and sovereign deployments are priced individually. Details on the [pricing](/pricing) page.
What currency do you invoice in?
We invoice at fixed list prices in the currency shown on the site. Clients in Uzbekistan can pay in soums at the Central Bank of Uzbekistan rate on the invoice date.
What does the subscription include?
The platform and the modules in scope, forward-deployed engineers, integration of your systems, model usage under the agreed plan, SLA support and quarterly impact reviews.
How is acceptance handled?
Each phase ends with a report, a demo and a signed acceptance certificate. Payment is by milestone.
How do you calculate payback?
We record baseline process metrics (time, volume, errors, losses) and measure the same metrics after the pilot. The difference in money, minus support and model costs, is the monthly impact.

groups.title: IT
items: Do we need to change our systems?
No. We connect to existing systems through APIs, database replicas or exports. Access is read-only by default.
Which systems do you integrate with?

ERP (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, 1C), CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics), databases and warehouses (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery), Kafka, document management, email, VoIP telephony, Teams, Slack, CCTV. Anything non-standard is assessed during the audit.
Where is the platform deployed?
In BlackGust Cloud, your private cloud, your own servers, or an air-gapped network. See [Deployment](/platform#deploy).
What servers do local models need?
It depends on load and the models chosen. Air-gapped deployments usually need GPU servers. We prepare the spec during the diagnostic.
How do users sign in?
Through your directory: Active Directory / LDAP, SAML or OIDC. Roles and groups are inherited.
Who supports the solution after launch?
We do, under an SLA. We also train your engineers and hand over documentation so you can make some changes yourselves.

groups.title: Security
items: Are models trained on our data?
No. Cloud models are accessed through enterprise APIs that don't train on customer data; local models run inside your infrastructure.
Do you meet data-residency requirements?
Yes. Personal data is stored and processed in the jurisdiction its law requires — in Uzbekistan, under the Law on Personal Data.
Can an agent do something without a human knowing?
Only what its configuration explicitly allows. Changing data, sending documents outside and legally binding actions all require human approval.
Can we review documentation before signing?
Yes. Under NDA we provide an architecture description and threat model, and we complete your security questionnaire. See [Security](/security).

groups.title: Department head
items: How much of my team's time will this take?
The process owner spends 2–4 hours a week during the pilot. Everyone else joins interviews and testing, 1–2 hours each.
Will AI replace my staff?
The goal is to remove routine so people can focus on work that needs their expertise. Decisions and approvals stay with people.
What if the AI gets something wrong?
Every answer links to its source, so errors are easy to check. Where mistakes are costly, a human approves. Errors we find are added to the reference tests so they don't recur.
Can we change agent instructions without a developer?
Yes. Instructions and rules are configured in the interface, and we train a designated person on your team to do it.

groups.title: Government & procurement
items: How can a government body contract with you?
Through a pilot project, a competitive tender, or a direct contract where procurement rules allow. We help prepare the specification and documentation.
Can it run without internet access?
Yes, in an air-gapped environment on local language models.
Can models be trained on our own data?
Yes. In a sovereign deployment, open models are fine-tuned on your documents and terminology inside your perimeter. Neither the data nor the trained weights leave your infrastructure.
Which languages are supported?

English, Russian and Uzbek out of the box, for the interface, agent answers and speech. Other languages, including Kazakh, French, German and Chinese, are configured per project. Uzbek works in both Latin and Cyrillic.
What documents do you hand over?
Project schedule, test program and methodology, user and administrator guides, and a report for each phase. See [Government](/government).

groups.title: Staff
items: How will staff use the system?
Wherever is convenient: in the web interface, in Teams or Slack, or by voice. There's no complex new software to learn.
Is there training?
Yes, on real tasks, by role, in the team's language. Plus short guides and a contact for questions.
Can the system read my personal messages?
No. Only sources agreed with the organization and its security team are connected, and every data access is logged.
